env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd dep
logos build -o $WORK/dep.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/dep.a __.LOGOS
cp stdout $WORK/dep.facts
grep '^fn Read ParamMutated=0$' $WORK/dep.facts
grep '^fn Write ParamMutated=1$' $WORK/dep.facts
grep '^fn \(\*Counter\)\.Add ReceiverMutated,ParamMutated=0$' $WORK/dep.facts
grep '^fn \(\*Counter\)\.Stash ReceiverMutated,ParamMutated=1$' $WORK/dep.facts
grep '^fn Counter\.Total ParamMutated=0$' $WORK/dep.facts
! grep '^fn Counter\.Total ReceiverMutated' $WORK/dep.facts
grep '^fn Leak ParamMutated=1$' $WORK/dep.facts

cd imp
logos build -o $WORK/bin/ok$GOEXE ./ok
exec $WORK/bin/ok$GOEXE
stdout '^read: 6$'
stdout '^show: shown$'
stdout '^sum: 6$'
stdout '^total: 13$'
stdout '^add: 14$'
stdout '^equal: true$'
cd ..

cd imp
! logos build -o $WORK/badwrite$GOEXE ./badwrite
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
stderr 'parameter b'
! logos build -o $WORK/badtrans$GOEXE ./badtrans
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
stderr 'parameter b'
! logos build -o $WORK/badstash$GOEXE ./badstash
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
stderr 'parameter xs'
! logos build -o $WORK/badleak$GOEXE ./badleak
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
stderr 'parameter b'
! logos build -o $WORK/badfillany$GOEXE ./badfillany
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
stderr 'parameter v'
! logos build -o $WORK/badapply$GOEXE ./badapply
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
stderr 'parameter b'
! logos build -o $WORK/badfuncval$GOEXE ./badfuncval
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! logos build -o $WORK/badsink$GOEXE ./badsink
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
stderr 'parameter b'
! logos build -o $WORK/badzero$GOEXE ./badzero
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
stderr 'parameter xs'
cd ..

cd imp
cp ../dep/dep.go.next ../dep/dep.go
! logos build -o $WORK/ok2$GOEXE ./ok
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
cd ..
cd dep
go build -o $WORK/dep-plain.a .
cd ..
! go tool pack p $WORK/dep-plain.a __.LOGOS

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/gopdep

go 1.27

-- dep/dep.go --
package dep

func Read(b []byte) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range b {
		n += int(v)
	}
	return n
}

func Write(b []byte, v byte) {
	b[0] = v
}

func Transitive(b []byte) {
	Write(b, 0)
}

func Show(v any) string {
	return "shown"
}

func FillAny(v any) {
	v.([]byte)[0] = 1
}

func Apply(f func([]byte) int, b []byte) int {
	return f(b)
}

func SumBytes(xs ...byte) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range xs {
		n += int(v)
	}
	return n
}

func ZeroAll(xs ...byte) {
	for i := range xs {
		xs[i] = 0
	}
}

var Held []byte

func Leak(b []byte) {
	Held = b
}

type Sinker interface {
	Sink(b []byte)
}

type Box struct {
	V int
}

func (b *Box) Sink(x []byte) {
	x[0] = byte(b.V)
}

func Drain(s Sinker, b []byte) {
	s.Sink(b)
}

type Counter struct {
	N     int
	saved []byte
}

func (c Counter) Total(xs []int) int {
	n := c.N
	for _, v := range xs {
		n += v
	}
	return n
}

func (c *Counter) Add(xs []int) {
	for _, x := range xs {
		c.N += x
	}
}

func (c *Counter) Stash(xs []byte) {
	c.saved = xs
}

-- dep/dep.go.next --
package dep

func Read(b []byte) int {
	b[0] = 1
	n := 0
	for _, v := range b {
		n += int(v)
	}
	return n
}

func Write(b []byte, v byte) {
	b[0] = v
}

func Transitive(b []byte) {
	Write(b, 0)
}

func Show(v any) string {
	return "shown"
}

func FillAny(v any) {
	v.([]byte)[0] = 1
}

func Apply(f func([]byte) int, b []byte) int {
	return f(b)
}

func SumBytes(xs ...byte) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range xs {
		n += int(v)
	}
	return n
}

func ZeroAll(xs ...byte) {
	for i := range xs {
		xs[i] = 0
	}
}

var Held []byte

func Leak(b []byte) {
	Held = b
}

type Sinker interface {
	Sink(b []byte)
}

type Box struct {
	V int
}

func (b *Box) Sink(x []byte) {
	x[0] = byte(b.V)
}

func Drain(s Sinker, b []byte) {
	s.Sink(b)
}

type Counter struct {
	N     int
	saved []byte
}

func (c Counter) Total(xs []int) int {
	n := c.N
	for _, v := range xs {
		n += v
	}
	return n
}

func (c *Counter) Add(xs []int) {
	for _, x := range xs {
		c.N += x
	}
}

func (c *Counter) Stash(xs []byte) {
	c.saved = xs
}

-- imp/go.mod --
module example.com/gopimp

go 1.27

require example.com/gopdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/gopdep => ../dep

-- imp/ok/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/gopdep"
)

func main() {
	b := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	var view const []byte = b
	fmt.Println("read:", dep.Read(view))
	fmt.Println("show:", dep.Show(view))
	fmt.Println("sum:", dep.SumBytes(view...))
	fmt.Println("equal:", bytes.Equal(view, b))
	is := []int{1, 2}
	var iview const []int = is
	js := []int{4}
	var jview const []int = js
	c := dep.Counter{N: 10}
	fmt.Println("total:", c.Total(iview))
	c.Add(jview)
	fmt.Println("add:", c.N)
}

-- imp/badwrite/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/gopdep"

func main() {
	b := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	var view const []byte = b
	dep.Write(view, 1)
}

-- imp/badtrans/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/gopdep"

func main() {
	b := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	var view const []byte = b
	dep.Transitive(view)
}

-- imp/badstash/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/gopdep"

func main() {
	xs := []byte{1, 2}
	var view const []byte = xs
	c := dep.Counter{}
	c.Stash(view)
}

	b := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	var view const []byte = b
	dep.Leak(view)

package main

import "example.com/gopdep"

func main() {
	b := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	var view const []byte = b
	dep.FillAny(view)

-- imp/badapply/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/gopdep"

func main() {
	b := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	var view const []byte = b
	dep.Apply(func(x []byte) int { return len(x) }, view)
}

-- imp/badfuncval/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/gopdep"

func main() {
	b := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	var view const []byte = b
	w := dep.Write
	w(view, 1)
}

-- imp/badsink/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/gopdep"

func main() {
	b := &dep.Box{V: 1}
	var s dep.Sinker = b
	buf := []byte{0}
	var view const []byte = buf
	dep.Drain(s, view)
}

-- imp/badzero/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/gopdep"

func main() {
	b := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	var view const []byte = b
	dep.ZeroAll(view...)
}
